long_biography.plain_text:
Pripuz Špekuljuk studied economics at the University of Zagreb and entered her family's waste-management business at 24. She worked across finance, accounting, controlling and planning, became a management-board member, and later headed C.I.O.S. Group. Her tenure placed her at the centre of a regional system handling recycling, metal recovery, waste collection and energy projects.

After the group professionalised day-to-day management, she moved from executive leadership to chair its supervisory board. She also chairs the supervisory board of Metis, a recycling company controlled by C.I.O.S. Her career reflects a structured family-business succession: long operational preparation, responsibility for financial discipline and a later governance role overseeing professional managers.
